mods.label: App & Keychain isolation
mods.description: Keeps Dia Custom's bundle, profile, Keychain label, and permissions separate from official Dia.

mods.label: Dia service isolation
mods.description: Blocks Dia and The Browser Company service, telemetry, crash, registry, and updater destinations while allowing normal browsing and selected providers.

mods.label: Disable stock updates
mods.description: Disables Sparkle app replacement so an official update cannot overwrite the custom browser.

mods.label: Custom updater
mods.description: Checks official releases in the app, verifies every enabled mod, and installs a staged custom build with app and profile rollback.

mods.label: Local AI routing
mods.description: Routes Dia's native chat protocol to the localhost provider bridge and preserves the agent sandbox.

mods.label: Anonymous local profile
mods.description: Uses Dia's anonymous dependency path so local chat can run without a Dia account.

mods.label: Import from official Dia
mods.description: Adds official Dia to the native browser importer through a sanitized, owner-only local staging copy.

mods.label: Native model picker
mods.description: Populates Dia's chat toolbar and View menu with models from the local catalog.

mods.label: Developer surfaces
mods.description: Exposes local routing and tool diagnostics plus Dia's native webpage developer tools.

mods.label: Native Mod Manager
mods.description: Adds a dedicated Mods tab to Dia Settings for configuring optional Dia Mods.

mods.label: Local Memory
mods.description: Provides profile-aware local Memory, history import, chat capture and recall. Manage it in Dia+ settings; mirrors Dia's native Memory controls only when that pane exists.

mods.label: Native Reports
mods.description: Enables Dia's native report workflow, sandbox validation, and Reports-library ingestion for the anonymous clone.

mods.label: Local public-web tools
mods.description: Replaces Dia-service web search and fetch with the bounded local public-web client.

mods.label: Local connectors
mods.description: Adds owner-controlled imported records and people lookup to the local tool layer.

mods.label: Native Apps state
mods.description: Feeds Dia's shipped Apps preference pane local Advanced Chat, profile, eligibility, and connection state.

mods.label: Live connector adapters
mods.description: Preserves browser-session connector tools and adds direct, owner-controlled OAuth/MCP adapters.

mods.label: Native Morning Brief
mods.description: Enables Dia's bundled Morning Brief UI and schedules its native Reports workflow with local state.

mods.label: Apple Foundation Models
mods.description: Builds and exposes the optional Apple on-device model helper.

mods.label: Local knowledge base
mods.description: Indexes imported documents and saved research with source provenance, separately for each Dia profile.

mods.label: Workspaces & Spaces
mods.description: Research reference only, not a usable mod. Preserves findings about native workspace/Spaces controls for possible future development.
mods.availabilityReason: Research reference only. Native Spaces state was enabled in research, but creation, switching and data boundaries are not tested and approved.

mods.label: Chat controls
mods.description: Research reference only, not a usable mod. Preserves findings about native reasoning and per-chat personalization controls for possible future development.
mods.availabilityReason: Research reference only. Think more regenerated responses in research, but provider reasoning and personalization semantics are not audited.

mods.label: Split View refinements
mods.description: Research reference only, not a usable mod. Preserves findings about native split toolbars, hover actions and drag previews for possible future development.
mods.availabilityReason: Research reference only. Split pane toolbars also exist with the flags disabled; hover actions and drag previews are not tested and approved.

mods.label: Browser Use & Tasks UI
mods.description: Research reference only, not a usable mod. Preserves findings about native sandboxed browser use and task surfaces for possible future development.
mods.availabilityReason: Research reference only. Browser Use & Tasks UI has no audited and approved native execution path.

mods.label: Local research and automations
mods.description: Runs local research and explicitly enabled schedules with read-only tools and stores their results in the local knowledge base.
